SELECT t1.id, t1.master_card_id, t2.id as master_id, t2.NAME, t2.phone, t1.family_no,t1.address, t1.village, (select count(*) from poor_family_user tt1 where tt1.family_id=t1.id) as family_count FROM poor_family t1 LEFT JOIN poor_user t2 ON t1.master_card_id = t2.card_id
and t1.master_card_id like concat('%', #{masterCardId}, '%') and t2.name like concat('%', #{masterName}, '%') and t1.family_no like concat('%', #{familyNo}, '%')

SELECT t1.id, t1.master_card_id, t2.id as master_id, t2.NAME, t2.phone, t1.family_no, t1.address, t1.village,t1.family_count FROM poor_family t1 LEFT JOIN poor_user t2 ON t1.master_card_id = t2.card_id
t1.id=#{id}

SELECT t3.dict_label as village,COUNT(*) as userCount FROM poor_family_user t1 LEFT JOIN poor_family t2 on t1.family_no=t2.family_no left join sys_dict_data t3 on (t3.dict_type='village' and t2.village=t3.dict_value) GROUP BY t2.village
